parsed.name: 安捷伦 E4406A 矢量信号分析仪
parsed.description: 这是一台台式射频频谱/矢量信号分析仪，可对无线与射频信号进行频谱观察、标记功率测量、带宽相关设置以及 IQ 数据采集。它常用于发射机表征、频谱监测、调制分析和射频实验调试。
parsed.description_en: This is a benchtop RF spectrum/vector signal analyzer used to observe signal spectra, measure marker power, configure bandwidth-related settings, and capture IQ data. It is commonly used for transmitter characterization, spectrum monitoring, modulation analysis, and RF lab troubleshooting.
